title: Mellow Yellow | KEY.co
description_expanded: Upstairs, the home continues to impress with three serene bedrooms—including two spacious king suites and a charming bunk room that opens onto a breezy second-floor porch with treetop views, a hammock, and a swing for laid-back lounging. Every space feels intentional, from the marble-drenched primary bath to the thoughtful porch access points throughout. With space for the whole family and then some, this coastal retreat offers the perfect balance of privacy, charm, and location—just 489 feet from the beach and a short stroll to Seaside’s iconic shops and restaurants. Whether it’s a quick getaway or a long-awaited reunion, this is the kind of home where memories are made. Tucked just steps from Seaside’s private Savannah Pavilion beach access, this grand corner beach bungalow captures the essence of Southern charm with sprawling wraparound porches and timeless design. From the moment you arrive, oversized screened porches with Adirondack chairs, a bench swing, and rocking chairs invite slow mornings, shaded afternoons, and cozy nights beneath the stars. Inside, an open-concept layout blends comfort and style with a generous living area, a rustic dining space for ten, and a renovated kitchen outfitted with glass tile, stainless-steel appliances, and a central island perfect for gathering.

Features: Toaster TV Dryer Washer Internet Air conditioning
